x-e-h1-01.title: Cas oko alingbi ti fa ndali ti tene 'ngbâ'?
x-e-h1-01.goal: Na texte ti argument, wara ligne so preuve akpe bâ so nzoni pëpe, gbu sika ni tongana phrase so abâ nzoni mingi, na decide preuve wa a hunda ti sika.
x-e-h1-01.material:
Ni ayeke ndo ti texte so a imprimer na journal ti ecole (nömörö ti ligne akomanse na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.

x-e-h1-01.prereq.1: Sens ti lâ na lâ so 'ndali' na 'asi na ngoi oko na hasard' alingbi ti ayeke nde

x-e-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Ligne 3 ayeke kpale. Tene so nömörö ayeke 'tâ' kiri ti 'student kue' na gi nömörö ti student oko so akiri (ligne 2) ayeke conclusion kota ahon preuve. Nömörö so akiri alingbi ti ayeke na ndali ti nde, tongana ngangu ti test wala bê-ti-mo. Ligne 4 amû ndali ti nde na nömörö (bruit, triche), ni la a lingbi ti bâ ni na tele ti ni na problème so. "Banned for everyone" na ligne 5 asi nga na conclusion so, me ndo so problème asi kozo ayeke ligne 3.

x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.d: Lege so a sara na téléphone na classe afa tâ pëpe lien na nömörö.
